entries.source:
A furious fire storm rages around the caster, doing %0.2f fire damage in a radius of 3 each turn for %d turns.
		You closely control the firestorm, preventing it from harming your party members.
		The damage and duration will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
制造一片激烈的火焰风暴，每回合对施法者周围 3 码范围内的目标造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害，持续 %d 回合。
		你精确地操控火焰风暴，阻止它伤害你的队友。
		伤害和持续时间受法术强度加成。

entries.source: Object will be equipped if possible, otherwise added to main inventory
entries.target: 如有可能，物品会直接装备上，否则放入物品栏。

entries.source:
Welcome #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#.
As you walk forward, you hear the increasingly loud cheers coming from outside.
As you step into the arena, the scorching sun blinds your eyes temporarily.
You look up, and meet your target eye to eye: The Master of the Arena, carefully examining
the newcomer. He smirks, and starts looking at the other fighters with interest.
Whoever defeats the Master of Arena will achieve utmost glory. 
Determined to win, you draw your weapons and advance defiantly. 
The public roars in anticipation....
entries.target:
欢迎你 #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#！
当你往前走时，你听到外面传来越来越高的欢呼声。
当你走入竞技场，灼热的阳光让你一时睁不开眼睛。
你抬头往前看，与你的对手四目相对。
竞技场主宰，小心翼翼地打量着这个新来的对手。
他得意地一笑，并开始把他的兴趣转移到其他的斗士身上。
击败竞技场主宰的人将获得最高的荣誉。
怀着必胜的决心，你拿起了你的武器，并勇敢的往前迈进。
观众们在期待中发出震耳欲聋的欢呼……

entries.source:
The golem self-destructs, destroying itself and generating a blast of fire in a radius of %d, doing %0.2f fire damage.
		This spell is only usable when the golem's master is dead.
entries.target:
傀儡引爆自身，自我摧毁并产生火焰爆炸，在 %d 码范围内造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害。
		这个技能只有傀儡的主人死亡时能够使用。

entries.source: This vial of blood was drawn from an ancient race in the Age of Haze. Some of the power and vitality of those early days of the world still flows through it. "Drink me, mortal," the red liquid seems to whisper in your thoughts. "I will bring you light beyond darkness. Those who taste my essence fear not the death of flesh. Drink me, mortal, if you value your life..."
entries.target: 这瓶血液是在混沌纪某个古老种族的身上抽取的。世界初生时的部分力量与活力，至今仍在瓶中流淌。“喝下我吧，凡人”，这瓶红色的液体仿佛在你的脑海中低语：“我会给你带来超越黑暗的光芒。品尝我精华的人将永远不会害怕肉体的死亡。喝下我吧，凡人，如果你珍惜你的生命的话…”

entries.source: The sandworms are gone, devoured by this shrieking, warped horror.
entries.target: 沙虫们已经消失了，被这只尖啸着的扭曲怪物吞噬殆尽。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Vim#LAST#
Vim represents the amount of life energy you control. Each corruption talent requires some.
It does not regenerate naturally; you need to drain it from yourself or your victims.
Each time you kill a creature you gain 50% of your Willpower + 1 as Vim.  This value is multiplied by the rank of the creature.
If you can't pay for the Vim cost of a talent you may instead pay with life at a rate of 200% of the Vim cost.
entries.target:
#GOLD#活力#LAST#
活力是你控制的生命能量。施放堕落系法术需要消耗活力值。
活力值不会自动回复，你需要从你自身和你的目标身上吸取。
每杀死一个生物可以吸收意志属性50%+1的活力值。从高分级的生物获得的活力值会乘以分级倍率。
如果你无法支付使用一个技能的活力值，你可以改为支付生命值，数额为活力值消耗的200%。

entries.source: The altar seems to react to the heart. You feel you could corrupt it here.
entries.target: 这个祭坛似乎对心脏起了反应。你感觉到你可以在祭坛上腐化它。

entries.source: You were part of a group of dwarves sent to investigate the situation of the kingdom of Reknor.
entries.target: 你是一支矮人小分队的一员，这支小分队被派往瑞库纳王国调查情况。

entries.source:
While your cosmic cycle is expanding, creatures in its radius have a %d%% chance to suffer the effects of aging; pinning, blinding, or confusing them for 3 turns.
		While your cosmic cycle is contracting, creatures in its radius suffer from age regression; reducing their three highest stats by %d.
		The chance and stat reduction will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
当你的宇宙圈在扩展时，其半径内的生物有 %d%% 的几率受到老化影响，被定身、致盲或陷入混乱 3 回合。
		当你的宇宙圈在收缩时，其半径内的生物会遭受年龄退行，三项最高属性减少 %d。
		几率和属性降低效果受法术强度加成。

entries.source: Target is reeling from an lightning shock, halving its stun and pinning resistance.
entries.target: 目标受到闪电冲击而踉跄，震慑与定身免疫减半。

entries.source:
Use the onboard short-range teleport of the Fortress to beam down to the surface.
	Requires being in flight above the ground of a planet.
entries.target:
使用堡垒自带的短程传送装置回到地面。
	需要在某个星球的空中飞行。

entries.source: Fire a slow bolt of a random element for %d damage. Damage increases with the magic stat.
entries.target: 发射一枚缓慢飞行的随机元素属性飞弹，造成 %d 伤害，伤害受魔力值加成。

entries.source: All mind criticals reduce the remaining cooldown of a random wild gift/psionic/afflicted talent by 2.
entries.target: 每次精神暴击都会使随机 1 个冷却中的自然/心灵/痛苦系技能的剩余冷却时间减少 2 回合。

entries.source: The target is surrounded by a psychic field, absorbing 50%% of all damage (up to %d/%d).
entries.target: 目标被灵能领域包围，吸收所有伤害的 50%%（最多 %d/%d）。

entries.source:
As you begin disarming the trap, you think you may be able to learn how it works by carefully dismantling it.  You estimate this will take up to #YELLOW#%d#LAST# uninterrupted turns.
	What do you want to do?
%s
entries.target:
当你开始解除陷阱时，你认为也许可以通过仔细拆解它来弄清它的工作原理。你估计最多需要花费#YELLOW#%d#LAST#个不受打扰的回合。
	你想做什么？
%s

entries.source:
Your alchemist bombs now affect a radius of %d around them.
		Explosion damage may increase by %d%% (if the explosion is not contained) to %d%% if the area of effect is confined.
entries.target:
炼金炸弹的爆炸半径现在为 %d 码。
		爆炸伤害可提高 %d%% （爆炸未受限制时）至 %d%% （爆炸范围受限时）。

entries.source: When last you saw it, this cavern was littered with the corpses of orcs that you had slain. Now many, many more corpses carpet the floor, all charred and reeking of sulfur. An orange glow dimly illuminates the far reaches of the cavern to the east.
entries.target: 你上次过来时，这个洞穴里满是你杀死的兽人尸体。现在，更多的尸体铺在了地上，尽皆焦黑，散发着刺鼻的硫磺味。昏暗的橙色光芒隐约照亮了洞穴东面的深处。

entries.source: An enormous ogre, clad in a tattered set of robes with an officer's badge.  She clutches a healer's staff, wrapped in casting plaster and scalpels for use as a massive spiked club.
entries.target: 一个巨大的食人魔，身穿一件别着官员徽章的破烂长袍。她紧握一把治疗用的法杖，法杖上裹满了铸型石膏和手术刀，被当作一根巨大的狼牙棒使用。

entries.source:
In Maj'Eyal threats are everywhere when you walk the wildlands, some rogues prefer to forgo the use of stealth instead using their cunning skills to kill silently from afar with a sling well protected with a buckler.

You have learned the power of counterstriking from afar and can now create characters with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Skirmisher class#WHITE#.

Skirmishers are highly mobile rogues that specialize in running and gunning, using Slings to harass, debilitate, and wear down enemies before finishing them off with extremely quick attacks.

Class features:#YELLOW#
- Vault and roll around your foes, staying one step ahead and just out of
reach
- Cripple your opponents and unleash a torrent of sling bullets
- Block enemy fire with your buckler mastery and counter attack#WHITE#

Skirmisher use stamina to fuel their techniques, which replenishes slowly over time.
entries.target:
当你漫步在马基·埃亚尔大陆上广袤的荒野之地时，你会发现威胁无处不在。一些盗贼放弃了传统的潜行手段，转而凭借诡诈的技能，在盾牌的保护下用投石索从远处悄然击杀对手。

你已经学会了从远处发动反击的能力，并且现在可以创建#LIGHT_GREEN#散兵#WHITE#这个角色

散兵是高度机动的盗贼，运用游击战术的好手，利用手中的投石索袭扰、削弱并消耗敌人，再以极快的攻击将其终结。

职业特点：#YELLOW#
- 跃过并翻滚绕开敌人，始终领先一步，保持在攻击范围之外
- 致残对手，并射出一阵投石索弹幕
- 凭借盾牌专精挡住敌人的远程攻击并反击#WHITE#

散兵使用体力值来施放他们的技能，体力值会随时间缓慢恢复。
